entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The largest polis on Theros, a city-state of philosophers, thaumaturges and oracles on the Siren Sea, ruled by the council known as the Twelve.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods and city-states where Meletis stands.

entities.name: The Twelve
entities.description: The council of philosophers that rules Meletis, elected for four-year terms.

entities.name: Perisophia
entities.description: The current leader of the Twelve, whose Elpidian school predominates Meletian thought.

entities.name: Elpidios
entities.description: An Epharan oracle and the first leader of the Twelve after Kynaios and Tiro.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: The immortal archon tyrant who ruled the region for centuries with an army of giants and leonin until overthrown.

entities.name: Kynaios
entities.description: A hero who, with Tiro, overthrew Agnomakhos with Ephara's aid and became a guardian and founder of Meletis.

entities.name: Tiro
entities.description: A hero who, with Kynaios, overthrew Agnomakhos and founded Meletis.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: The god and patron of Meletis, who armed Kynaios and Tiro with magic, set its legal code, and defended it during the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr planeswalker who attacked the poleis, caused the Silence of the Gods and ascended to godhood as God of the revels.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: The Sun god's champion who led armies against the minotaur siege of Akros and was scapegoated and exiled.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god who sought to destroy Xenagos and made Daxos his champion.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: A renowned oracle transformed by Heliod into his demigod champion.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: The only god who seemed aware of the threat posed by Xenagos.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: The period when the gods went blind and cut off from their oracles during Xenagos's attacks.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A Phyrexian planeswalker who led the first wave of the New Phyrexian Invasion on Theros.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault that targeted temples on Theros and compleated most of the gods.

entities.name: Kroxa
entities.description: An underworld creature whose voiding maw obliterated Phyrexian invaders.

entities.name: Reverent Army
entities.description: Meletis's religiously trained army, using griffin and pegasus mounts.

entities.name: Dekatia Academy
entities.description: The elite academy for philosophers and mages in Meletis.

entities.name: Medomai
entities.description: A wise and ancient sphinx oracle whose appearances are viewed as bad omens.

entities.name: Tromokratis
entities.description: A kraken that partially destroyed the Pyrgnos around 4550 AR.

entities.name: Pyrgnos
entities.description: A glowing stone tower serving as lighthouse and repository of scholarship, repaired after the kraken's attack.

entities.name: Four Winds Plateau
entities.description: A sacred bone-white tableland near Meletis, site of many battles and declared temenos by the gods.

entities.name: Lagonna Band
entities.description: Peaceful centaurs north of Meletis who trade with the polis.

entities.name: Callaphe
entities.description: The plane's greatest mariner and trickster, later chosen as Thassa's demigod.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A gifted athlete and planeswalker from Meletis.

entities.name: Thrasios
entities.description: A triton hero who lives among the humans of Meletis.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: A god of Theros who chose Callaphe as her demigod and champion.

events.summary: Kynaios and Tiro, aided by Ephara's magic, overthrow the tyrant Agnomakhos and cast out the leonin.
events.quote: With their new power, Kynaios and Tiro overthrew Agnomakhos, cast out the leonin, and freed Meletis from tyranny.

events.summary: Meletis is founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire and Kynaios and Tiro relinquish power to a philosopher-led republic.
events.quote: which ultimately led them to relinquish their power and establish a philosopher-led republic

events.summary: In 4559 AR Xenagos gathers monsters to attack Meletis, Akros and Setessa, causing the Silence of the Gods.
events.quote: These attacks became so severe that the gods themselves went blind

events.summary: Xenagos ascends to godhood during the siege of Akros and Elspeth is scapegoated and exiled.
events.quote: In circumstances largely under mystery , Xenagos managed to ascend to godhood.

events.summary: Heliod makes the oracle Daxos his champion and orders him to remove the other gods from Meletis; the gods go to war.
events.quote: he pulled the soul of the oracle Daxos and transformed him into his champion in the mortal realm

events.summary: In 4562 AR Phyrexian forces compleat most of the gods; Meletis holds out with Ephara's aid and Kroxa obliterates invaders outside.
events.quote: Meletis stood as the last bastion of resistance against an endless onslaught of Phyrexian armies.

events.summary: The kraken Tromokratis partially destroys the Pyrgnos around 4550 AR.
events.quote: Partially destroyed by the kraken Tromokratis around 4550 AR

events.summary: Ephara keeps her temple standing through an earthquake and later shares designs so Meletis can be rebuilt.
events.quote: Ephara kept her temple standing throughout the mighty quake
